_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the model catalog. Edit ONLY this file. tools/db-migrate/seed/fixtures/Model.json and packages/control-plane-ui/public/provider-templates/*.json + index.json are GENERATED from it by tools/db-migrate/gen-model-catalog.mjs and byte-checked by `npm run check:model-catalog`. Schema: see the generator header. CEILINGS (maxOutputTokens / maxContextTokens): when a live probe and the vendor's official docs disagree, take the MINIMUM. A ceiling we publish on /v1/models is one callers echo back, so a number the wire rejects turns our own advertisement into a 400; under-declaring costs only headroom. Example: the o-series live probe answers "supports at most 100003" while developers.openai.com documents 100,000 max output tokens — the catalog carries 100000. Do not "correct" it back from a probe alone.
